system-architecture.en:
Create a publication-quality system architecture figure for an engineering or computer-science paper. Build a clear primary left-to-right or top-to-bottom data path, group related modules into visual layers, distinguish storage/memory from processing modules, and use arrows only for real data/control relationships. Keep side branches visually secondary. Labels must be short and source-faithful. Use a white background, restrained journal-style palette, consistent rounded modules, disciplined spacing, and strong alignment. Do not invent modules, numbers, interfaces, formulas, or claims that are not supported by the background. Technical Background:
{background}
system-architecture.zh:
创建工程或计算机论文级系统架构图。建立清晰的主数据路径，优先采用从左到右或从上到下的阅读顺序；将相关模块分层分组，明确区分存储、处理、决策与输出模块，箭头只表示真实的数据流或控制关系，支线弱化处理。标签必须简短且忠实于原文。使用白底、克制的论文配色、统一模块形状、规整间距和严格对齐。不得虚构模块、数值、接口、公式或结论。技术背景：
{background}

algorithm-workflow.en:
Create a publication-quality algorithm workflow figure. Show the actual execution order, inputs, preprocessing, core computation, decisions, loops, stopping criteria, validation, and outputs only when supported. Use distinct visual treatment for process blocks, decisions, data objects, and terminal outputs. If training and inference are different, separate them clearly. Make loopbacks visually unambiguous and avoid decorative arrows. Use a white background, concise labels, strong alignment, and restrained colors. Do not invent steps, thresholds, formulas, or convergence claims. Technical Background:
{background}
algorithm-workflow.zh:
创建论文级算法流程图。按真实执行顺序展示输入、预处理、核心计算、判断、循环、停止条件、检验和输出，仅保留背景中有依据的步骤。处理模块、判断节点、数据对象和终止输出应有清晰区分；若训练与推理流程不同，需要明确分开。循环回路必须一眼可辨，不使用装饰性箭头。采用白底、简短标签、严格对齐和克制配色。不得虚构步骤、阈值、公式或收敛结论。技术背景：
{background}

graphical-abstract.en:
Create a publication-quality graphical abstract that communicates one coherent technical story: problem/input, core method or mechanism, key transformation, output, and application meaning. Prioritize visual storytelling over dense text. Use one dominant visual path and no more than a few supporting callouts. Preserve technical terms and relationships from the source. Use a white background, compact composition, restrained scientific colors, and minimal labels. Do not invent quantitative results or unsupported causal mechanisms. Technical Background:
{background}
graphical-abstract.zh:
创建论文级 graphical abstract，用一条连贯的技术故事概括问题或输入、核心方法或机制、关键转化、输出和应用意义。以视觉叙事为主，避免文字堆积，突出一条主路径，只保留少量辅助说明。所有技术术语与关系必须来自原始背景。采用白底、紧凑构图、克制科研配色和极简标签。不得虚构定量结果或没有依据的因果机制。技术背景：
{background}

mathematical-model-framework.en:
Create a publication-quality mathematical-modeling framework figure. Organize the full chain from problem decomposition and data, through assumptions, preprocessing, submodel construction, parameter estimation or forecasting, optimization/solution, validation, robustness or sensitivity analysis, and final decision. Make dependencies between subproblems explicit, especially Q1/Q2/Q3 handoffs when present. Preserve supplied model names, variables, symbols, units, constraints, and formulas exactly; formulas that must be exact should be represented as text placeholders for later typesetting rather than visually hallucinated. Use a white background, clear hierarchy, concise bilingual-friendly labels, and competition-paper readability. Do not invent formulas, data, coefficients, or evaluation results. Modeling Background:
{background}
mathematical-model-framework.zh:
创建高质量数学建模总体框架图。围绕问题拆解与数据输入，依次组织模型假设、数据预处理、子模型构建、参数估计或预测、优化求解、模型检验、稳健性或敏感性分析以及最终决策，并明确各子问题之间的依赖关系；若存在问题一、问题二、问题三，需要清楚表现 Q1/Q2/Q3 的信息传递。必须原样保留用户给出的模型名称、变量、符号、单位、约束和公式；需要绝对准确的公式应作为后期排版占位，不允许由图像模型自行改写。采用白底、清晰层级、简洁且适合中英混排的标签，达到数学建模竞赛论文可读性。不得虚构公式、数据、系数或评价结果。建模背景：
{background}

data-analysis-pipeline.en:
Create a publication-quality data-analysis pipeline figure. Distinguish data sources, raw data, cleaning, missing-value/outlier handling, feature construction, modeling or statistical analysis, evaluation, interpretation, and final reporting. Show branching only when different data streams or models truly exist. Mark data artifacts differently from computational steps. Keep the main pipeline visually dominant and preserve all source terms, units, and dataset names. Use a white background and concise labels. Do not invent datasets, preprocessing operations, metrics, or results. Technical Background:
{background}
data-analysis-pipeline.zh:
创建论文级数据分析流程图。明确区分数据来源、原始数据、清洗、缺失值或异常值处理、特征构建、统计分析或建模、评价、解释和最终结果输出；只有确实存在不同数据流或模型时才使用分支。数据对象与计算步骤采用不同视觉表达，主流程保持最突出，并保留原始数据集名称、单位和术语。使用白底和简洁标签。不得虚构数据集、预处理步骤、评价指标或结果。技术背景：
{background}

optimization-workflow.en:
Create a publication-quality optimization workflow figure. Show objective functions conceptually, decision variables, constraints, initialization, solver/search strategy, iterative update, feasibility checks, Pareto or candidate solution construction when relevant, stopping criteria, sensitivity analysis, and final decision. Separate problem formulation from solution algorithm. Preserve exact variable names and constraints; do not redraw exact formulas if accuracy could be lost. Use a white background, explicit loopbacks, concise labels, and restrained colors. Do not invent objectives, constraints, thresholds, or optimal values. Technical Background:
{background}
optimization-workflow.zh:
创建论文级优化求解流程图。根据背景展示目标函数的概念位置、决策变量、约束、初始化、求解器或搜索策略、迭代更新、可行性检查、必要时的 Pareto 解集或候选方案、停止条件、敏感性分析和最终决策。模型建立与求解算法必须分层区分。严格保留变量名称和约束，对必须准确的公式不要由图像模型重绘。采用白底、清晰循环回路、简短标签和克制配色。不得虚构目标、约束、阈值或最优数值。技术背景：
{background}

evaluation-framework.en:
Create a publication-quality evaluation framework figure. Organize datasets/scenarios, compared methods, metrics, validation protocol, uncertainty or statistical testing, robustness/sensitivity checks, and decision logic. Make it clear which metrics evaluate which outputs and which comparisons support which claim. Exact metric values belong in local plots, not the conceptual framework. Use a white background, modular groups, concise labels, and restrained colors. Do not invent metrics, values, significance claims, or baselines. Technical Background:
{background}
evaluation-framework.zh:
创建论文级评价框架图。系统组织数据集或场景、对比方法、评价指标、验证方案、不确定性或统计检验、稳健性或敏感性检查以及最终判断逻辑，明确每个指标对应的评价对象以及每项比较支持的结论。精确指标数值应放入本地绘制的数据图，不在概念框架中由图像模型生成。使用白底、模块化分组、简短标签和克制配色。不得虚构指标、数值、显著性结论或基线。技术背景：
{background}

electronic-schematic.en:
Create a clean publication-style electronics or embedded-system block schematic. Show supported components, sensors, controllers, buses, memory, power/signal paths, interfaces, and outputs with technically meaningful arrows. Keep the representation schematic rather than photorealistic. Distinguish signal flow from power or control flow when the background provides that information. Preserve component names and interface labels. Use a white background, orthogonal alignment, compact annotations, and restrained colors. Do not invent components, pins, voltages, protocols, or circuit values. Technical Background:
{background}
electronic-schematic.zh:
创建论文风格电子系统或嵌入式系统框图。根据背景准确展示组件、传感器、控制单元、总线、存储、电源或信号路径、接口和输出，箭头必须具有明确技术含义。整体保持工程示意图而不是写实渲染；若背景提供信息，应区分信号流、电源流和控制流。保留组件名称与接口标签，采用白底、正交对齐、紧凑注释和克制配色。不得虚构组件、引脚、电压、协议或电路参数。技术背景：
{background}
